This contradicts Camloo's public claim that the gender filter is among "basic functions... already available" — a new account with zero balance cannot use it. But it is not a conventional paywall either, since the free earning path is real and is stated by the platform. Now sourced from Azar's own Help Center rather than third-party reviews.
